jobs.occupation: Lead Engineer – Electrical and Control Systems
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your DayAs a Lead Engineer within Siemens Energy’s Modifications & Upgrades organization, you will play a key role in delivering modernization and upgrading projects for our global fleet of gas and steam turbines.You will be responsible for the technical coordination of the electrical and control system scope throughout the project lifecycle, from sales support and engineering to commissioning and customer handover. Working closely with project managers, customers, suppliers, commissioning teams, and engineering specialists, you will ensure that the technical solution is clearly defined, coordinated, and successfully executed.The role combines technical leadership, project execution, problem-solving, and customer interaction in an international environment. You will join a highly skilled and supportive team working with complex technical challenges, modern control systems, digitalization, and lifetime extension solutions for our installed fleet.How You’ll Make an Impact    Lead and coordinate the electrical and control system scope in modernization and upgrading projects.    Develop a clear technical execution plan, define deliverables and interfaces, and drive activities from planning through commissioning.    Act as a key technical interface towards customers, project management, suppliers, commissioning teams, and internal engineering functions.    Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities and ensure alignment between technical disciplines and project requirements.    Identify and manage technical risks, changed conditions, and complex engineering challenges throughout project execution.    Lead technical discussions and contribute to solutions that improve plant performance, reliability, availability, and sustainability.    Support modernization initiatives such as control system upgrades, system migrations, obsolescence management, digital solutions, and performance improvements.    Enable, motivate, and support project team members to achieve common goals and deliver successful project outcomes.    Contribute technical input to quotations and support the early definition of project scope, assumptions, and risks.What You Bring    A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, or equivalent relevant work experience.    Several years of experience in control system engineering, electrical engineering, commissioning, technical project leadership, or modernization projects.    Experience with industrial control systems such as Siemens Energy SPPA-T3000, PCS 7, PCS neo, DCS, PLC, or equivalent automation platforms is highly meritorious.    Experience from power generation, gas turbines, steam turbines, process industries, or other complex industrial environments is advantageous.    Experience from modernization, upgrade, migration, retrofit, or obsolescence management projects is considered a strong merit.    The ability to structure and drive technical work while managing several stakeholders and priorities.    Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to represent the technical scope in customer and project meetings.    A solution-oriented, responsible, flexible, and organized approach, combined with a strong desire to learn and develop.    A collaborative leadership style and an interest in enabling and supporting colleagues across functions and cultures.    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.About the TeamYou will be part of Siemens Energy’s Modifications & Upgrades organization, which delivers modernization, upgrade, and lifetime extension solutions for the installed fleet of gas and steam turbines.Our work is performed in close collaboration with customers and colleagues across engineering, project management, sales, procurement, manufacturing, field service, and commissioning. We value technical curiosity, openness, teamwork, and continuous improvement, and we support each other in finding robust solutions to complex challenges.Our Gas Services division provides service, modernization, digitalization, and decarbonization solutions for gas turbines, steam turbines, and generators.What We Offer    A role with significant technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence projects from early definition to final delivery.    Work with advanced technology and challenging international projects in a collaborative environment.    Opportunities for professional development, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing within a skilled engineering community.Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.Who is Siemens Energy?At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to DiversityLucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative ener

Bring more to life.Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology? At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies. At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist to support the development of innovative scientific imaging products and analytical workflows at Cytiva. The successful candidate will contribute to the design and user validation of new products, with a strong focus on fluorescence-based applications and imaging technologies. This role requires close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders across international organizations.The Scientist reports to the Senior Manager, Protein Research Systems, part of the wider Protein Research R&D department, and will be an onsite role based in Uppsala, Sweden.What you'll do:    Lead and support the development of new imaging-based products and applications from concept through verification and user validation.    Design, execute, and analyse experiments, for example involving fluorescent dyes, chemiluminescence, and phosphor imaging.    Develop and optimize workflows related to electrophoresis, nucleic acid and protein analysis, and image-based quantification.    Evaluate imaging performance, sensitivity, reproducibility, and usability of new systems and applications.    Contribute to technical documentation, protocols, design reviews, and regulatory documentation as required.    Support customer and user studies to ensure products address real-world user needs, for example by leading beta-user testing.The essential requirements of the job include:    Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, Imaging Science, or a related scientific discipline.    Strong hands-on experience with fluorescence-based detection methods and fluorophores.    Experience in applications such as Western blotting, nucleic acid gel electrophoresis, fluorescence imaging, chemiluminescence detection, phosphor imaging, multiplex multi-well plate analysis, or related workflows.    Experience with quantitative image analysis, data interpretation, and statistical evaluation of imaging performance.    Demonstrated ability to independently plan and execute complex experimental studies with limited supervision.    Experience developing, testing, and validating scientific instruments, assays, or research products.    Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively in English-speaking, cross-functional, and international teams.It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:    Knowledge of optical imaging systems, detector technologies (CCD, CMOS, sCMOS, PMT, SPAD, or related technologies), illumination systems, and image quality metrics is advantageous.    Experience with laboratory imaging systems such as gel documentation systems, fluorescence imagers, chemiluminescence imagers, phosphor imagers, microscopy systems, or multimode imaging platforms.    Familiarity with scientific image file formats and metadata standards (e.g., TIFF, JPEG, and other proprietary instrument formats).    Experience with user-cantered product development and usability testing.    Understanding of regulated development environments, quality systems, or design control processes.    Experience working with software-controlled instrumentation and digital image workflows.We’re looking for someone with a collaborative mindset who enjoys working across disciplines, functions and geographies. You are curious and innovative, with a genuine passion for scientific problem-solving and finding practical solutions to complex challenges. You bring a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work while remaining pragmatic and adaptable. With strong interpersonal and communication skills, you build productive relationships easily and thrive in a dynamic environment where you can manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

jobs.occupation: Head chef to Mr.Bronck & Sallys at Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
jobs.description: Stockholm outside, a world of guests inside, and a kitchen ready for your ideas. It´s time to bring your flavour to Sheraton Stockholm.  Sheraton Stockholm has been bringing people together in the heart of the city since 1971. Today, we’re shaping our next chapter, with a major transformation, fresh energy and new places to eat, drink and connect. With Archer Hotel Management as our operator and Marriott International as our brand family, we combine an international outlook with a strong sense of place. Now we’re looking for a Head Chef to lead the food experience at Mr. Bronck, Sally’s and our room service operation. Someone with a clear culinary point of view, a head for business and the ability to build a team people want to be part of.  From dinner at Mr. Bronck to food that complements a cocktail at Sally’s or a great meal delivered upstairs, you’ll make sure every experience feels considered, consistent and right for the setting. You’ll lead the daily a la carte kitchen operation and develop seasonal menus that give each concept its own character. Taste, presentation and timing matter equally, and you know how to deliver all three when service picks up. Behind every great service is a well-run kitchen You’ll take ownership of menu costing, purchasing, stock control and staffing, keeping quality high and food waste low. You’ll turn business forecasts into smart schedules, maintain strong food safety and HACCP routines, and keep a close eye on the financial performance of the operation. Just as importantly, you’ll recruit, coach and develop your team. You set clear expectations, share your knowledge and stay approachable under pressure. Working closely with colleagues across the hotel, you’ll help create a seamless experience for our guests. A creative chef and a grounded leaderYou bring at least five years of experience in a similar leadership role in a quality restaurant or hotel kitchen. You’re confident developing menus, leading busy services and balancing culinary ambition with commercial results. You care about the details and understand how your decisions affect the whole operation. You bring structure, curiosity and high professional standards, and you enjoy finding practical solutions when plans change. Your team can count on you for direction, support and a steady presence during a demanding service. You communicate confidently in English; Swedish is a plus. An established network within the industry is also welcome. Make your mark on our next chapterThis is an opportunity to influence the food, develop your team and help shape the next chapter of an iconic Stockholm hotel. You’ll join an international, inclusive workplace with opportunities to grow within Sheraton and the wider Marriott family, alongside access to employee hotel rates around the world. We offer a permanent, full-time position with a six-month probationary period and terms covered by a collective bargaining agreement.Are you ready to bring your ideas to the table?Send us your application. We review applications and meet candidates throughout the recruitment process, so the position may be filled before the closing date. Let’s create something worth coming back for.

Mat4Green Tech AB (M4GT) is a Chalmers University spin-out based in Gothenburg. We develop and commercialise closed-loop processes for recovering and refining metals from industrial materials, with our own lab and pilot facilities in Gothenburg. We are now looking for a chemist who will take hands-on ownership of our recycling and purification work.About the roleYou will run and develop hydrometallurgical and electrochemical processes in our lab and pilot facility, from leaching and solvent extraction to electrolysis and final purification. You plan, build and manage your own projects: you define what equipment and materials are needed, find and negotiate with suppliers, carry purchases through, and keep the work documented and safe. The Plant Coordinator supports the coordination and management of plant, vehicles, tools, and assets across operations in Sweden. The role supports asset management activities, lifecycle planning, and operational asset performance. The role supports plant availability, maintenance coordination, and efficient utilisation of company assets. The role works with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and service providers to support asset management, regulatory compliance, and commercial objectives.How this role lives our values This role supports the effective management of plant and assets by helping ensure that equipment, vehicles, and resources are available, maintained, and correctly managed throughout their lifecycle. By maintaining visibility of asset performance, availability, and compliance requirements, the role supports efficient operations and informed decision-making. Safety: Support a safe working environment by helping ensure assets, vehicles, equipment, and inspection requirements are managed in accordance with company and regulatory standards. Integrity: Support accuracy, accountability, and compliance through effective record management, asset tracking, and adherence to established processes. Teamwork: Build strong working relationships that support collaboration, communication, and coordinated asset management activities. Ownership: Take responsibility for following through on actions, resolving operational issues, and supporting the effective management of company assets. Sustainability: Support long-term value creation through responsible asset management, efficient utilisation, and sustainable lifecycle practices. Key ResponsibilitiesPlant & Asset Lifecycle Management:     Coordinate plant, vehicle, tool, and asset activities throughout the asset lifecycle, including receipt, return, allocation, and disposal in line with project requirements.     Support asset management strategies and asset replacement or upgrade planning. Maintenance & Compliance Coordination:     Coordinate planned and unplanned maintenance activities, inspections, testing requirements, and equipment compliance activities.     Maintain up-to-date asset records, tracking information, and compliance documentation, including leased and hired assets. Asset Operations & Procurement Support:     Coordinate plant movements, operational requirements, procurement activities, and supplier engagement.     Support commercial decision-making relating to plant acquisition, hire, utilisation, and cost management.     Support the procurement of fuel, spare parts, and other plant-related requirements. Sustainability & Asset Optimisation:     Support effective asset utilisation, reuse, sale, recycling, and sustainability initiatives in line with the company’s sustainability strategy. Fleet & Incident Coordination:     Coordinate fleet-related incidents, repairs, and recovery activities.    Coordinate vehicle maintenance requirements in line with applicable regional requirements. Health, Safety & Regulatory Compliance:     Support compliance with safety, environmental, sustainability, regulatory, and internal company requirements. Commercial Administration:     Support the effective management of plant and asset-related costs.     Reconcile monthly invoices and account statements relating to plant and assets. Key Requirements     3rd level qualification or equivalent experience in procurement, purchasing, commercial functions, or construction plant operations.     Experience in a similar position (typically 3 years or more).     Knowledge of plant and asset management.     Knowledge of Swedish regulatory requirements and construction industry standards.     Experience using asset management systems and tools.     Analytical skills, process awareness, and attention to detail.     Communication, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement skills.     Fluent English; Swedish language skills are advantageous.     Valid Swedish or EEA driver's licence.Skills     Plant and asset management knowledge.     Regulatory compliance knowledge.     Asset management systems knowledge.     Analytical and process management skills.     Stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.     Commercial awareness. A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.It’s a plus if you have    GraphQL, Kafka or other event-streaming technologies    AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB or SQS    Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD    SQL and NoSQL databases    Experience from automotive, connected vehicles, telecom or other product-focused environments    Experience operating and improving production servicesThe mindset we’re looking forFor us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

As Head of the Avionics & Electrical Department, you will play a central role in shaping the electrical and electronic architecture of our satellite platforms and ensuring the reliable performance of our missions. Our customers include major space companies, agencies, and commercial players across Europe and worldwide.OHB Sweden develops advanced small satellite systems for scientific and Earth observation missions. These missions require highly reliable avionics and electrical systems that form the backbone of the spacecraft, enabling power generation and distribution, communications, command and data handling, and mission operations.The Avionics & Electrical Department is responsible for the design, development, verification, and support of the satellite's electrical and electronic systems. The department currently consists of approximately 23 highly skilled engineers and specialists working in areas including:    Electrical Architecture    Electrical Power Systems (EPS)    TT&C and Communications Systems and RF Systems    EMC / EMI    Electronics Design    Radiation Engineering and EEE Component Usage    Data Handling Systems and Onboard Computers    Harness Design    FPGA Design    EGSE designThe department contributes throughout the complete spacecraft lifecycle, from early mission concepts and proposal activities, through design studies, detailed development, subsystem and system verification, launch preparation, and operational support.The space industry is evolving rapidly, driven by increased satellite autonomy, software-defined systems, miniaturized electronics, higher levels of integration, growing constellation markets, and increasing demands on cybersecurity, resilience, and manufacturability. At the same time, OHB Sweden is transitioning towards a higher degree of productization and industrialization of its satellite platforms. In this context, the Avionics & Electrical Department will play a key role in defining future platform architectures, technologies, methodologies, and engineering practices. As Head of Department, you will lead this evolution and ensure OHB Sweden remains a competitive and technically leading provider of advanced small satellite systems.As Head of the Avionics & Electrical Department, you will be mainly responsible for:    Driving staff recruitment, onboarding, and development to build a motivated and high-performing team.    Managing resource planning to balance project demands and support business growth, in close collaboration with project managers and other department heads.    Acting as a key point of contact for customers, partners, and suppliers on avionics, electrical, communications, electronics, and onboard computing matters.    Ensures that engineering processes relevant for the department activities exist and are properly implemented.    Ensures that proper engineering tools are efficiently used in the department    Owns the department ways-of-working.    Implementing strategic and operational decisions from the Company Management Team within the department.    Ensuring the department's skills and expertise align with the evolving needs of the company and its projects.    Reporting to employees and managers.    Overall responsibility for the technical deliveries from the department to the project in quality, time and cost.    Managing resource planning to balance project demands and support business growth, in close collaboration with project managers and other department heads.    Contributing to proposals by estimating costs and evaluating staffing.    Leading budgeting within your area of responsibility, covering general expenses, training, laboratories, equipment, and investments.What We're Looking For    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline.    At least 10 years of experience as an engineer and technical leader within avionics, electronics, electrical systems, communications, or a related field.    Proven leadership skills, with experience managing teams and coordinating complex, multidisciplinary engineering activities.    Strong understanding of spacecraft avionics and electrical systems, including electrical architectures, power systems, communications, onboard computing, electronics development and testing.    Understanding of EMC, radiation effects, reliability, and engineering standards applicable to space systems.    Strong analytical skills and the ability to foster innovation and continuous improvement within the team.    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.    Fluency in English; knowledge of Swedish is a plus.    A collaborative mindset, with experience working in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.What We Offer    A unique opportunity to lead one of the key engineering departments responsible for the core avionics and electrical capabilities of our satellite platforms.    Involvement in all phases of satellite projects, from early studies and proposal work to launch and operations.    A supportive and innovative work environment, with opportunities for personal and professional growth.    Competitive salary and benefits, with flexibility for work-life balance.The Head of Avionics & Electrical Department will report to the Head of Engineering & Technology and play a key role in the company's technical leadership team. This position may require occasional travel, primarily within Europe.Join us and help shape the next generation of satellite avionics and electrical systems!

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description: Om skolanInternationella Engelska Skolan Liljeholmen är en grundskola med årskurs F-9 som ligger vid Midsommarkransen, nära både tunnelbana och buss. Skolan startades 2014 och har idag över 120 anställda och ca 1200 elever. Om du vill arbeta i en internationell miljö med en stödjande kultur är IES Liljeholmen platsen för dig. Vi har en bred elevgrupp som talar omkring ett 50-tal olika modersmål samt en personalgrupp som är internationellt rik. Vi vill uppmuntra och stödja internationellt utbildade lärare som börjar hos oss på IES Liljeholmen att både lära sig svenska samt komplettera sin lärarutbildning för att nå en svensk lärarlegitimation på sikt.Om tjänstenInternationella Engelska Skolan Liljeholmen söker för närvarande en behörig lärare i bild och textilslöjd i årskurs 5, 7 och 8. Du kommer att ingå i arbetslaget för årskurs 5 och dela mentorsansvar för en klass samt undervisa bild och textilslöjd. Tjänsten är ett visstidskontrakt från februari 2027 - januari 2027 med eventuell förlängning.Din profilDu är en kvalificerad lärare för de angivna ämnena och åldersgrupperna. Vi hoppas att du inser vikten av att bygga och upprätthålla goda relationer med kollegor, elever och föräldrar. Du är motiverad att ha regelbunden kontakt med föräldrar, leda mentorstimmar enligt mentorprogrammet och arbeta tillsammans i en stödjande miljö. Det finns inget krav på tidigare lärarerfarenhet, men vi värdesätter ditt självförtroende i ditt professionella ledarskap och din förmåga att skapa en trygg och stabil miljö både i och utanför klassrummet. Du värderar och levererar personligt, tydligt och balanserat ledarskap med fokus på både struktur och elevengagemang. Som lärare är du en tydlig och aktiv förebild.AnställningsprocessVi kommer att hålla löpande intervjuer för tjänsten, så vi rekommenderar att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Om du tror att detta kan vara rätt tjänst för dig, tveka inte att ansöka! Vi ser fram emot att ta del av din ansökan och få möjlighet att diskutera tjänsten och dina kvalifikationer närmare.Övrig informationAlla Internationella Engelska skolor runt om i landet delar samma vision för utbildning, kallad IES Ethos. Läs gärna mer om detta för att se om det överensstämmer med dina egna professionella värderingar och övertygelser. På IES erbjuds alla anställda en pedagogisk lunch. IES följer Almega kollektivavtal för fristående skolor.Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.
